candidates.issuer: ITC Academic Computing, University of Sharjah
candidates.extraction: GOOD WITH MINOR CLEANUP (stray callout numbers; page 14 image-dominated)
candidates.hold_reason: 25 pages. The frozen Teaching calendar-row index (teaching.py, built from every 'row' chunk whose page is in the handbook calendar pages) and the Institutional page-start index (institutional.py _page_starts_clean, the last paragraph of every page number) are keyed by page number without a source filter, so the PF-2 collision check refuses the whole Plan F registry for any enabled guide with pages at or above 14 (the lowest scoped handbook page). Ingesting it needs a decision record that makes those frozen indexes source-aware, with its own evaluation.
